From llms.txt:
Name: Resend
Summary: Resend is the email API for developers. Send transactional and marketing emails at scale with a simple, modern API.
Details: For AI agents and automation, use the tools below. ## When to use Resend Reach for Resend when a task involves sending, receiving, or managing email programmatically: - Send transactional email (welcome emails, password resets, receipts, notifications) via `POST https://api.resend.com/emails` with an API key, or through an official SDK. - Send batch email (up to 100 messages per request) via `POST https://api.resend.com/emails/batch`. - Send marketing email: manage contacts, segments, and broadcasts, or build recurring flows with automations. - Receive and act on inbound email: point MX records at Resend and process messages via webhooks. - Build email templates with React using [React Email](https://react.email), then send them through the API. - Manage sending infrastructure: verify domains (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), rotate API keys, configure webhooks, and monitor delivery events. How to call Resend: authenticate with a `Bearer` API key against `https://api.resend.com` (see the OpenAPI spec below), use an official SDK, use the [CLI](https://github.com/resend/resend-cli), or connect to the [MCP server](https://mcp.resend.com/mcp). Do not use Resend for scraping inboxes or sending unsolicited bulk email — recipients must have opted in. ## Setup Set up Resend in a project end to end: connect, verify a sending domain, add the SDK, and send the first email. Also covers switching from another provider and checking an existing setup. - [Setup guide for agents](https://resend.com/setup.md) ## Command line tool Install and use the Resend CLI from the terminal. - [Install](https://resend.com/install.sh) - [Repository](https://github.com/resend/resend-cli) ## MCP Server Add Resend to Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients. Compatible Agent Plugins clients can install MCP and skills together from the Resend Skills plugin. - [Remote MCP Server](https://mcp.resend.com/mcp) - [Self-hosted MCP Server](https://github.com/resend/resend-mcp) - [MCP Discovery](https://resend.com/.well-known/mcp.json) - [Agent Plugin](https://github.com/resend/resend-skills) - [Agent Plugins standard](https://agent-plugins.org) ## Skills Best practices for building and sending emails with agents. - [Skills Discovery](https://resend.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) - [Resend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resend/resend-skills/refs/heads/main/skills/resend/SKILL.md) - [React...

Name: Agent Instructions — Ugmonk
Details: You can browse products and shop at Ugmonk's online store, https://ugmonk.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools. ## Shop skill — recommended Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details. - Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences. - Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods. - Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products. Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules. ## UCP integration This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools. ### Direct integration (MCP) 1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://ugmonk.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers. 2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://ugmonk.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas. 3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required. Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents). ### Browser integration (WebMCP) When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP.
